title: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users crea
question:
What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(p.XCL_037) AS avg_up_votes,
    AVG(u.XCL_053) AS avg_user_age
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
GROUP BY p.XCL_033
HAVING COUNT(p.XCL_026) > 10

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(u.XCL_061) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
   WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT XCL_033 FROM posts GROUP BY XCL_033 HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)) * 1.0 /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts GROUP BY XCL_033 HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)

basic_execution_correction.reason: Removed the GROUP BY clause from the main query to return a single scalar row as required by the contract. Moved the 'more than 10 posts' filtering logic into a subquery using IN to correctly filter the users before calculating the global averages. Also corrected the source of 'up votes' to use the votes table (votes.XCL_066) as indicated by the relational program, instead of a user column.
